scheme.canonical: b'zabalack\x00v1\x00' + UTF-8 of json.dumps(intent, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
scheme.mac: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical bytes, lowercase hex

test_keys.construction: key_text repeated and cut to key_length bytes; ASCII, so one byte per character
test_keys.key_text: zabalack synthetic test key, public, never for production use.
test_keys.warning: Public test material. Never use these keys, or keys built this way, outside tests.

vectors.name: ascii-k32
vectors.description: ASCII intent; minimum key length (32 bytes).

vectors.name: ascii-k128-kid-charset
vectors.description: Same intent; maximum key length (128 bytes); a kid using every allowed character class.

vectors.name: unicode-bmp-sorted-customers
vectors.description: Non-ASCII text is written as raw UTF-8, not \u escapes (ensure_ascii=False). Customers are sorted by code point, which is also UTF-8 byte order.

vectors.name: unicode-astral
vectors.description: A character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane is written as four raw UTF-8 bytes, not a surrogate pair.

vectors.name: json-escapes
vectors.description: Only the quotation mark and the backslash are escaped. "/", DEL (U+007F) and U+2028 are written unescaped.

vectors.name: admin-true-empty-customers
vectors.description: Boolean true and an empty customer list.

vectors.name: payload-at-limit
vectors.description: The JSON payload after the 12-byte prefix is exactly 16,384 bytes, the largest accepted. canonical_hex is omitted; compare length and SHA-256.

refusals.name: payload-over-limit
refusals.description: One payload byte over the limit (16,385) is refused.

refusals.name: customers-not-canonical
refusals.description: Actor customers that are not sorted and unique are refused.

refusals.name: unpaired-surrogate
refusals.description: An unpaired UTF-16 surrogate (written here as the JSON escape \ud800) cannot be encoded as UTF-8 and is refused. A Rust String cannot hold it, so an implementation that parses this file may report a parse error instead.
